settings.eyebrow: The Open Door Collective · Street outreach · Housing first · No wrong door
settings.headline:
Nobody should have to
sleep rough tonight.
settings.copy: The Open Door Collective is a street-outreach and housing-first organization. Our teams walk the sidewalks, underpasses, and encampments of our city every night — building trust, meeting basic needs, and moving people from the street into a home of their own.

trust_list.text: Outreach teams on the street 365 nights a year
Housing first — a home before any other requirement
No ID, no sobriety test, no judgement to get help
Free food, water, blankets, and harm-reduction supplies

settings.title: A door opened is
settings.intro: We measure success in people, not numbers — but the numbers show what steady, patient outreach can do.

settings.title: From the sidewalk
settings.intro: We meet people exactly where they are — physically and in their lives — and we never ask them to become someone else before we help.

features.title: Night outreach
features.text: Our teams walk the same routes every night so people come to know us. Trust is built one conversation, one blanket, one shared meal at a time.

features.title: Basic needs first
features.text: Hot food, water, clean socks, blankets, and harm-reduction supplies — no questions, no forms. You can't plan a future on an empty stomach.

features.title: Housing first
features.text: We move people into a home of their own first, then wrap support around them. A stable address is the foundation everything else is built on.

features.title: Case management
features.text: One worker stays with each person through benefits, ID, healthcare, and employment — at their pace, for as long as it takes.

features.title: Rapid re-housing
features.text: When someone is ready, we move fast — deposits, first month's rent, furniture, and a warm handoff to a landlord who says yes.
features.detail: From street to keys in weeks

settings.title: We walk with you,
settings.intro: There is no wrong door and no wrong time. Here's what the journey from the street to a home looks like with us.

steps.title: We meet you
steps.text: Our team finds you where you are — a sidewalk, a shelter, a hospital, a bus stop. We introduce ourselves, share a meal, and listen. No pressure, no pitch.

steps.title: We earn your trust
steps.text: We keep showing up, night after night, until you know our faces. We help with what you ask for first — a blanket, a phone call, a ride — and we never judge.

steps.title: We find you a home
steps.text: When you're ready, we move you into a place of your own. We cover the deposit and first months, furnish it, and get your benefits and ID sorted.

steps.title: We stay
steps.text: We keep checking in for as long as you want us to — groceries, healthcare, a job lead, or just a coffee. A home is the start, not the finish.

settings.note: You never have to be sober, employed, or 'ready' to get our help. Housing first means we help you get a home, and then we help you build the life you want inside it.

settings.title: Be the reason someone
settings.intro: Your gift buys blankets, hot meals, harm-reduction supplies, and the deposits that turn a street corner into a front door. Every dollar moves someone closer to a home.
settings.quote: I'd been on the street for eleven years. They didn't ask me to get clean or get a job first. They just found me an apartment, and then they helped me keep it. That's the whole secret — someone believed I could.

settings.title: A home changes
settings.intro: The people we serve, and the people who serve with us, on what a door and a key can do.

reviews.quote: They found me under a bridge in January and just kept coming back. By spring I had keys to my own place. I still can't believe it's real, but I'm sitting in it right now.
reviews.author: Rosa

reviews.quote: I volunteer on the night team. We don't fix anyone — we just show up and care. And somehow, that's exactly what people need to start believing in themselves again.
reviews.author: Devon

reviews.quote: As a landlord I was nervous at first. The Collective guaranteed the rent, furnished the place, and stayed involved. Two years later my tenant is still there and thriving. I'd do it again in a heartbeat.
reviews.author: P. Okafor

settings.title: One email a month,
settings.intro: A short monthly note on our night teams, the people we've housed, and the simple ways you can help. No guilt, no spam, unsubscribe anytime.

settings.title: Call us. Find us.
settings.intro: If you or someone you know is sleeping rough, call our 24/7 line and we'll send a team out to meet you. If you want to help, we'd love to hear from you too.

settings.blurb: The Open Door Collective is a street-outreach and housing-first organization meeting people where they are and walking with them from the street to a home of their own.
